seo.title: Learn digital
seo.description: Four ways in to learn digital from Dakar: the blog, the podcast and videos, the courses, the Digitos Club. What's open comes before what's paid for.
seo.jsonLdDescription: Max-Morrys's learning track: articles, podcast and videos, courses and the Digitos Club.

hero.lede: Four ways in, and one rule that doesn't move: what's open comes before what's paid for. You can read and listen to everything with no account and nothing handed over. The rest comes after, if you want to go further.
hero.tagPaid: What's paid for is named as such
hero.note: I don't ask for your address to let you read or listen. You'll need one the day you enrol in a course, not before.

entries.intro: They're in this order on purpose. What opens without you handing anything over comes first, what costs money comes next — and I'd rather tell you now than halfway through.

blog.body: Methods, written down. How a Dakar shop shows up on Google Maps, what to do with a page that sells nothing, how a product listing holds together. The examples are taken from here: “Cosmétique Almadies”, not “organic skincare Brooklyn” — what your own customers type, in the words they use.
blog.who: For you if you want to do it yourself, without buying anything first.
blog.cost: Nothing. It all reads without an account.

media.body: People from here telling you what they actually did — what worked, and what cost them dearly. No tutorials: voices, and their transcript when there is one.
media.who: For you if you want to hear someone out before making up your mind.
media.cost: Nothing. Listening asks for no account and no subscription.

formations.body: Guided paths: lessons in order, missions to hand in, and a certificate at the end — the very one that gets checked further down.
formations.who: For you if you want a progression, not pieces picked up at random.
formations.cost: Paid, per course, no subscription. What opens without paying is written on each course's page.

club.title: The Digitos Club
club.body: Where the people you hear on the podcast are. Live sessions, mutual help, and the things that don't go on a public page.
club.who: For you if you've already started and going it alone is starting to weigh.
club.costBilledSuffix: once a year. It can't be toured — that's the price of keeping it closed.

verify.body: A certificate issued here can be checked publicly. An employer, a client, a panel types in the code printed on the document and gets an answer — no account, no need to contact me, nothing to pay. The lookup leads back to no profile: it's a code that answers, not a person.
verify.note: It's the cheapest proof I know of, and the rarest: it happens without me, and it can prove me wrong.
verify.provenTitle: What you can check here without an account
verify.withheldTitle: What this page puts no figure on
proven: A certificate code can be checked publicly, with no account and no link handed to you first.
The blog and the media hub open without signing up: you can check for yourself before believing me.
The Club's price is written on this page, by the month and by the year.
withheld: No rating, no reviews, no member count: the platform has just opened and I have nothing honest to say about it.
No completion rate: you'd need finished paths to work one out, and I'm not going to invent the figure meanwhile.

end.title: Not sure where to start?
end.body: Write to me. I answer myself, and I'll tell you whether what I do answers your question — or whether it isn't worth it.

v3.seoDescription: Digital marketing, SEO, AI: short courses paid once with Wave, Orange Money or card, yours forever, with a mission in every lesson.

hero.lede: Digital marketing, SEO, AI. You pay with Wave, Orange Money or card, access opens right away, and it's yours forever.

why.title: Learn by doing, on your real project.
why.body: Every lesson ends with a mission: your Google listing, your offer, your first post. At the end you don't have a notebook, you have something online.

trainer.title: Max-Morrys, from Douala
trainer.body1: Economist by training, digital marketer by trade. Head of digital marketing at Eyone Medical, founder of MY ONOMA, trainer since 2024.
trainer.body2: I teach what I apply every day, with the tools and payment methods used here.

skills.title: What you'll learn
skills.lede: Six skills, spread across the courses. Each ends with a mission.

niche.title: Find your niche
niche.body: Pick a customer you can serve this very week.

offer.title: Write an offer that reads
offer.body: A promise, a price, a proof you can show.

google.title: Get found on Google
google.body: Business listing, neighbourhood keywords, real reviews.

publish.title: Post without burning out
publish.body: A sustainable calendar, three formats that work.

measure.title: Measure what matters
measure.body: Three numbers that decide, not thirty.

courses.title: The courses
courses.lede: Each course is paid once and stays yours. Its free lessons can be read without an account.
courses.emptyBody: Sign up below: you'll get an email the day the first one opens.

rysmo.title: Rysmo IA, your assistant
rysmo.sub: It answers about the lesson in front of you.
rysmo.demoQ: My Google listing has few reviews. How do I get more without buying them?
rysmo.demoA: Ask right after a job well done, with a short message and the direct link to your listing. Want me to help you write it for your shop?
rysmo.demoTag: example conversation · quota shown before every question

club.title: Alone, you learn. In the Club, you move forward.
club.body: Club member: −{{discount}}% on every course and {{bonus}} more Rysmo IA questions a day.

truth.title: What I don't show
truth.body: No rating, no enrolment count: the platform has just opened and I have nothing honest to say about it yet. Reviews will appear after moderation.

mission.title: Make digital learnable, payable and verifiable.
mission.body: No jargon, no income promises. Methods that work with a phone, an average connection and a shopkeeper's budget.
